scope: Recover initially blocked composed boundary connections using observed corridor obstacles and bounded horizontal moves under the existing shared work budget. Every accepted result reroutes and independently validates the complete composition; no incomplete seed is published.
behavioral_evidence: Public solve_composed fixture independently places two frames. Its target is sealed by clearance-inflated boxes and fails without feedback; recovery completes the original cross-frame relationship while preserving pins. Both settings perform exactly one initializer per frame; feedback trials use the explicitly larger total budget.

Public cached solve succeeds, then a newer revision pins the movable blocker shut. Failure preserves cache size and contents and revision watermark; prior revision restores identical assembly/routes with zero evaluations.

Actual fixed child boundary at (50,100,50) with inward normal (0,-1,0) is blocked by a box at [40,94,40]..[60,98,60]. One twelve-unit horizontal move opens the unchanged boundary. Complete topology, membership, joins, dimensions, layers, domains and transforms validate.

Two touching blockers require two successive moves. A one-trial budget returns the original failure with no accepted improvement; two trials produce a complete valid solution. Rejected overlap geometry consumes its trial before a later legal proposal succeeds.

Pinned/frozen subtrees, fixed hosts, domain limits, original diagnostic retention, reversed/input-reordered requests, cancellation, invalid input and strict sixteen-block evidence cap are covered by focused core/router/helper tests.

review.findings: Root reviewed routing wrapper/validator extraction, failure evidence, movement helpers, recovery integration and public/private regressions. Independent read-only integration review found no actionable correctness defect. Search exhaustion remains bounded heuristic failure, not proof of infeasibility.
review.versions: Private placement algorithm key revision 2; state remains v5, composition 1 and quality 5. No public contract/dependency/production-default changes.

representative_probes.scope: Eight previously valid headless development reports match the prior checkpoint in every field except timings. These cases exercise regression preservation, not new recovery coverage, calibration or held-out quality acceptance. Timings are single sequential samples.

production_source.scope: Bevy syntax source inventory, not full runtime architecture extraction.

native_pins.input_mode: Scripted ViewerActions only. Hardware keyboard/mouse messages, button states, accumulated deltas and cursor hover are discarded after Bevy InputSystems and before runtime Update controls. Native window/update settings are unchanged; the window may activate. This proof does not verify physical OS input delivery.
native_pins.scope: Actual native composed display and isolated v5 persistence. Exact rendered pinned position checked across collapse/reopen/unpin/undo and parent return; exact canonical point and truncated anchors checked through database/table descent. Child-origin pins preserve their original anchors when displayed in parents, including collapse/reopen, open-origin navigation and undo. Inheritance never copies owned registry entries. Restart and eviction have separate worker/core regressions; this process does not simulate hardware input or establish latency percentiles.
native_pins.visual_observation: Parent Orders view renders ten objects/seven paths after returning with a child-origin pin. Small nested interiors and obscured labels remain; this is not comprehension evidence.

native_production.input_mode: Scripted ViewerActions only. Hardware keyboard/mouse messages, button states, accumulated deltas and cursor hover are discarded after Bevy InputSystems and before runtime Update controls. Native window/update settings are unchanged; the window may activate. This proof does not verify physical OS input delivery.

persistence.scope: Synchronous main-thread state preparation and atomic save, including existing-state validation, serialization, file/directory fsync. Acceptance and frame intervals include this cost when enabled. The fresh temp directory is retained for inspection; no user state is read or written.

surface_summary.scope: CPU scheduling bracket before/after Bevy prepare_windows in the render schedule, including time to schedule either marker and concurrent render work. This is not exclusive function time or GPU time. It covers swapchain acquisition/reconfiguration for all extracted windows; a call may reuse an existing texture. Render invocation numbers are independent of main frame IDs. Correlate by shared-clock start/duration offsets. Markers add ordering constraints/overhead but leave prepare_windows and window settings unchanged.

native_production.measurement_scope: One native scripted-action regression run with persistence/tracing and no screenshots or OS sampling. User previews remained open; no hardware-input/GPU presentation or controlled latency-improvement claim.

limitations: Greedy bounded recovery uses at most the existing feedback allowance and only named obstacles from one short corridor per actual failure. It cannot certify infeasibility or guarantee recovery from arbitrary constraints.
Keeps box sizes, frame domains, layers and dyadic scales fixed. Enlarging routing space, changing parent ports jointly, and broader negotiated congestion placement remain future work.
Existing/reused frames remain frozen during ordinary navigation and repair; explicit reorganization may search free frames. Recovery cannot silently relax pins or accepted-frame stability.

The new blocked cases are headless fixtures through real routing and validation. Native runs verify regression safety of viewer actions and saved layouts, not a native display of the sealed synthetic fixture or physical keyboard/mouse delivery.

Native production again showed a 1,067.8 ms render handoff overlapping a 1,065.7 ms surface-acquisition bracket while unfocused with last-observed occlusion false. Cached repository collapse took 117.3 ms. Responsiveness targets and GPU presentation remain open.
Broader topology/group/reference overrides, repeated scale measurements, calibrated held-out comparison and human comprehension gates remain incomplete; the overall plan stays active.
